findings.body: The diff introduces a new TOML key `reasoning_effort`. If the Rust struct that deserializes this file uses `#[serde(deny_unknown_fields)]` or similar strict parsing, this addition will cause a configuration parse error at startup. The author should confirm that the struct has a corresponding field or that unknown fields are permitted. I cannot verify this because I cannot access the Rust struct definition.
findings.title: Verify that the config parser accepts 'reasoning_effort' key

value.summary: This change updates the model tiers (`scan`, `deep`, `fallback`) and adds a `reasoning_effort` key. The TOML syntax is valid, but the new key may not be recognized by the Rust config parser if the corresponding struct uses strict deserialization. Verify that the config struct accepts this key before merging.
